description: Compute return on investment as a percentage from an initial and final value, and optionally the annualized return given a holding period in years. Unlike the present-value or compound-interest calculators, which grow a sum at a known rate, this derives the realized rate from actual start/end values. Pure arithmetic, no live rate feed.

finalValue.description: The ending investment value (cannot be negative)

initialValue.description: The starting investment value (must be greater than zero)

years.description: Optional holding period in years, may be fractional; when provided, the annualized (CAGR) return is also computed

name: calculate_roi
